title: Knowledge
description: Knowledge bases with documents and tables: chunked, indexed and available for vector, keyword, hybrid and SQL search.

empty.title: No knowledge bases yet
empty.description: Create a base, upload PDF, Word, Excel or CSV files and your agents will cite them and query them with SQL.

card.errors: {count, plural, one {# file with errors} other {# files with errors}}

hint.shadow: Nothing is hidden, but every query reports what would have been filtered or masked.
hint.enforce: Row filters and masks are applied per role in the console, search and agents.

models.local: Local multilingual model (data never leaves your infrastructure)
models.offline: No model: deterministic hash, works offline
models.bedrock: Amazon Bedrock in the EU region

create.title: New knowledge base
create.description: Documents are chunked and indexed automatically; spreadsheets become tables.
create.name: Name
create.modelHint: It cannot be changed later: every vector in a base uses the same model.

settings.title: Base settings
settings.description: Name, description and chunking of new documents.
settings.chunkingHint: Chunking changes apply to files uploaded or reprocessed from now on.

detail.deleteDescription: Its files, chunks, tables, policies and backups will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
detail.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted or belong to another organization.

files.dropHint: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, CSV, HTML, Markdown, text or .eml emails. Up to {max} MB per file, several at once.

empty.title: No files
empty.description: Upload documents to index them. You will see each one's progress live.

files.deleteDescription: The file and its chunks will be deleted. Agents will no longer find it.
files.deleteTableDescription: The file and the tables created from it will be deleted.
files.showing: Showing {shown} of {total} files. Use search to find the rest.

tables.description: Structured data of the base. Query it with SQL and join it with documents.
tables.imported: {count, plural, one {Table created} other {# tables created}}
tables.emptyHint: Import a CSV or Excel file (each sheet becomes a table with detected types) or sync data from a connector.
tables.noFilters: No filters: all rows are shown.
tables.policyApplied: Policies for your role are applied: some rows or columns may be hidden or masked.
tables.loadWarnings: Last load: {invalid} invalid values were left empty and {skipped} rows without a key were skipped
tables.editHint: double-click a cell to edit it
tables.typeDescription: Existing values are converted to the new type. Spanish and English formats are accepted (1.234,56 · 31/12/2025).
tables.conversionFailed: {count, plural, one {# value cannot be converted} other {# values cannot be converted}}
tables.force: Convert anyway (invalid values will be left empty)
tables.deleteDescription: The table and all its rows will be deleted. Queries and agents using it will stop working.

hint.timestamp: Date and time (UTC when no zone is given)

sql.paramInvalid: A parameter does not have a valid value for its type.
sql.idle: Write a read-only query and press ⌘ Enter. Use $1, $2… for parameters and embed('text') to get a vector.
sql.policyShadow: In shadow mode, policies would have applied to
sql.breakGlassDescription: Runs the query without the policies that allow it. It is recorded in the audit log with your reason.
sql.breakGlassHint: For example: legal request, security incident. At least 5 characters.
sql.readOnlyHint: Read-only: one statement per query, with time and row limits, and only on this base.

chunks.emptyHint: Chunks appear when a document finishes processing.
chunks.reembedHint: When you save, keyword search updates immediately and the vector is recomputed in the background.
chunks.heading: Heading
chunks.deleteDescription: It will no longer appear in searches. Reprocessing the file generates it again.

modeHints.hybrid: Combines meaning and words (Reciprocal Rank Fusion)
modeHints.vector: By meaning, even with different words
modeHints.keyword: Full text in Spanish and English

search.idleDescription: This is how agents find passages in your documents.
search.noResultsHint: Try other words or the vector search.

policies.modeDescription: Choose whether policies are ignored, simulated or enforced.
policies.adminOnly: Only administrators can change the mode and the policies.
policies.title: Policies per role
policies.description: Filter rows and mask columns depending on who queries: people by role, or agents.
policies.formDescription: All policies of a table for the role combine: filters add up and the most restrictive mask wins.
policies.emptyHint: Add policies to hide personal data or restrict rows to certain roles.
policies.rowFilterDocumentsHint: SQL condition over filename and metadata (e.g. metadata->>'confidential' IS NULL).

maskHints.hash: Stable fingerprint: joins work without revealing the value

policies.breakGlassHint: An administrator can bypass this policy by giving a reason; it is audited.
policies.deleteDescription: The data it protected will be visible again for that role.

entities.description: Duplicate records across tables found by tax ID (NIF/CIF/VAT), email, domain or similar names.
entities.queued: Looking for duplicates: results will appear in a few seconds
entities.mergeDescription: Pick the right value for each field. The golden record is stored, audited and available in the SQL view entities.
entities.emptyHint: Press “Find duplicates” after importing or syncing tables with customers, suppliers or contacts.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Full on-demand copy: tables, chunks with their vectors, files manifest, policies and entities.
backups.emptyHint: Create a backup before important changes so you can go back.
backups.restoreDescription: The current contents of the base will be replaced with the backup from {date}.
backups.deleteDescription: You will not be able to restore it afterwards.

picker.selected: {count, plural, one {# base selected} other {# bases selected}}
picker.error: The bases could not be loaded.
